title: App theme & navigation shell
description: Set up Compose theme (colors/typography) and the top-level NavHost with placeholder destinations for each major module.
acceptanceCriteria: App has a consistent Material theme

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - LODGY-1 already built a Material3 LodgyTheme with the brand color scheme, so this is mainly the NavHost + bottom navigation shell. Building 5 top-level destinations (Home, Property, Tenants, Payments, More) matching the bottom-nav structure from the just-approved wireframe set, with placeholder screens behind each. Auth/PIN lock is a separate gate outside this NavHost (LODGY-4/5's concern), not a nav-bar tab.

Board-hygiene fix: this was left In Progress after the initial commit even though ui/nav/LodgyNavHost.kt (LodgyTheme applied in MainActivity, 5-destination bottom nav: Home/Property/Tenants/Payments/More) has been the live, working navigation shell every subsequent ticket built its screens into - the 'placeholder screens' AC has long since been superseded by real screens for every destination. Both AC verified directly by code and by this session's own repeated `gradlew assembleDebug` BUILD SUCCESSFUL runs across dozens of tickets that all depend on this NavHost working. Moving to Testing to reflect actual state rather than leaving a stale In Progress on the board.

PASS - confirmed implicitly across this entire testing pass rather than in isolation: consistent Material3 theme and a working Home/Property/Tenants/Payments/More bottom nav were exercised continuously through dozens of screens (property setup, tenant onboarding, billing, checkout, notes, expenses) with no visual inconsistency, dead route, or navigation dead-end encountered anywhere.
